thread:
aj: FYI — uploaded the new Notification Matrix + Suppression schedule mocks. Looking for quick UX + a11y sanity checks before I push to dev. https://framer.mock/redwood/notify-matrix :eyes:

mira: Nice. First glance: the matrix is dense. Can we collapse channel rows into a single expandable row? Hard to scan on smaller widths.

devon: Expandable rows sounds good. Also we need to think about how this maps to the backend policy model (we store per-channel rules). If collapsed, we should still show the active rule summary. e.g. "Email: critical only, SMS: all sev".

samira: A11y notes: keyboard order is weird — tab hits the presets, then the matrix, then the suppression start, but users expect left-to-right/top-to-bottom. Need a predictable tab sequence. Also aria-labels missing on the severity toggles.

aj: Good catches. On tab order I prototyped logical DOM order but the visual grid is tricky. Open to suggestions for how to keep visual grid but linear keyboard flow.

mira: One pattern — keep the DOM linear per-row, and add `role="grid"` + `aria-rowindex`/`aria-colindex` on interactive cells. That lets screen readers announce position but keeps keyboard linear.

samira: Yes. Also add `aria-pressed` for the toggle buttons instead of relying solely on `aria-checked` on a div. Example snippet: ```html
<button role="switch" aria-checked="true" aria-label="Email: notify on critical">Critical</button>
```

devon: Minor: the toast preview (right side) should show real channel names and the exact copy that flows to upstream. Right now it says "You have a trigger" which is too vague.

aj: Agreed. We'll show a live preview per channel, use the actual templated copy. Thoughts on making the preview toggleable? Some folks found it noisy.

mira: Make it collapsible and collapsed by default on narrow screens. Expand-on-hover for desktop maybe.

samira: Contrast check — the muted state for a disabled channel uses #7a7a7a on white; fails AA for small text. Need to bump to at least #6a6a6a or change weight.

aj: Noted. I'll update tokens. Any feedback on the suppression schedule UI? I added presets: 30m, 2h, 8h, 24h, and a custom cron-ish picker.

devon: Cron-picker might be overkill. Operators usually want simple windows (until tomorrow 9am / until next maintenance window) or an ISO-8601 duration. Suggest: presets + custom duration input (e.g., "4h 30m") and a date-time toggle for absolute end.

mira: The presets should surface which channels they apply to (global vs per-channel). Right now it's ambiguous. Maybe a small pill next to the preset: "Applies to: All channels".

samira: Also keyboard-accessible shortcuts: pressing "S" when focused on a rule could open the suppression modal. Ensure we don't conflict with browser shortcuts.

aj: Good call. We'll scope the shortcut to when focus is within the matrix container.

devon: Another edge case: if a user sets overlapping suppressions (global 4h + channel-level 2h), what should take precedence? Current design hides the conflict. We should show a conflict badge and the effective end time.

mira: +1 show effective end time in the summary row. Users hate surprises when alerts show up unexpectedly.

samira: Copy nit for the suppression confirmation modal: "Pause notifications for 2 hours" -> prefer "Pause notifications until [time]". It's clearer and reads better with screen readers.

aj: Will do. Also thinking about the severity selector UX — currently we use checkboxes for severities (P1, P2, P3). Multiple selections allowed. Any objections to switching to a compact multi-select dropdown to save horizontal space?

mira: Multi-select dropdown hides obvious state. I prefer the inline chips for quick glanceability. Maybe make chips wrap to multiple lines on small screens.

devon: Inline chips are fine but make sure they have a focus ring and keyboard removal (backspace) support.

samira: For screen readers, label chips like "P1 selected, toggle to deselect". Also ensure the order of severities is P1->P5 semantically, not alphabetical.

aj: Great. I'll update the mock: keep chips, ensure wrap, add focus/aria cues, bump disabled color contrast, change suppression presets to "duration + absolute end" model, add conflict badge, and make preview collapsed by default on mobile.

deploy-bot: Reminder: design review scheduled with Eng on Tue 11:00 AM. Calendar invite sent.

mira: One final note — think about a microcopy helper for new users: a small "How it works" tooltip for the matrix header explaining "rows = notification channels, columns = severity". People still get confused.

aj: Good idea. I'll add a tooltip and a short inline explainer. Action items for next steps: 1) aj update mock + token changes, 2) devon to confirm backend mapping for conflict resolution, 3) samira to review ARIA attributes after mock update, 4) mira to prototype row collapse animation. Back at you all by EOD Friday. :thumbsup:
